title: Certify: degree minimality in the equivariant class of the Alpöge Keller map, and the moment-map structure of its cotangent lift (certificates and verification scripts)
description: Machine-verified structural results about L. Alpöge's degree-7 Keller counterexample to the Jacobian conjecture in dimension three (announced 2026-07-19; problem posed by Akhil Mathew). CLAIMED AS NEW: (1) a degree-minimality theorem in the C*-equivariant class of weights (1,-1,-2) -- no Keller map of degree at most 6 exists in the sector where C involves s (the sector containing Alpöge's map), and every degree-<=6 Keller map elsewhere in the class is a polynomial automorphism -- by eight msolve Gröbner-basis unit-ideal certificates over Q reproduced mod 32003, with a degree-7 positive control; this strengthens T. Shaska's Theorem 10.10 (arXiv:2607.20210), which settles the sub-case where A and B have degree one in the invariants and explicitly leaves the general case open (his Remark 10.11); (2) the moment-map identity nu o Phi = mu for the Hamiltonian lift of the C*-action to T*C^3, and a no-go lemma valid at every degree and every weight. NOT CLAIMED, AND FULLY CREDITED: the map F is Alpöge's; the Weyl-algebra endomorphism refuting the Dixmier conjecture for n >= 3 AND the symplectic cotangent lift Phi(q,p) = (F(q), (JF)^{-T} p) are both W. G. P. Mayner's (Secret Blogging Seminar comment 2026-07-20; github.com/wmayner/dixmier-counterexample, commits of 2026-07-21, REPORT.md section 8) and are re-verified here only; the master equation and the base-point/anchor identity are T. Shaska's (arXiv:2607.20210v2, 2026-07-25, Thm 8.3 and Lem 8.5), the order-two vanishing on the contracted locus his v1 Thm 6.1 (2026-07-22); the exact image theorem and fiber counts 3/1/0 are in the anonymous note at ulam.ai/research/jacobian.pdf (2026-07-20, Thm 4.2); the S_3 monodromy is in MathOverflow 513387 and A. Lou (both 2026-07-20). Those results are retained in the paper for self-containedness with priority credited. The Poisson-conjecture statement (PC_n false for n > 2) follows formally from Mayner's Dixmier result via Adjamagbo-van den Essen and is already asserted in secondary sources; our contribution there is the explicit witness, its degrees and momenta, and the quantization identity gr Psi_F = Phi*. All verification scripts (SymPy 1.14) and msolve 0.10.1 certificate inputs/outputs are included; computations carried out with Claude (Fable 5). Everything is in characteristic zero; JC_2, DC_1, DC_2 and unconditional degree-7 minimality remain open.
notes: The Alpöge announcement of 2026-07-19 has no standalone URL in our records; the Secret Blogging Seminar post above is the public record used here and should be replaced by the canonical announcement URL if one exists.
